stats.fact: LearnHouse leads the category with 1,900+ GitHub stars and supports auto-grading in 30+ programming languages
Moodle, the traditional open-source LMS, has 7,290+ stars but is PHP-based and not designed for developer self-learning paths
SkillTreeOSS uses a DAG-based skill tree with spaced repetition, similar to Anki but with prerequisite mapping between concepts
Reasonote generates 8 different activity types (roleplay, sequencing, term-matching) using AI to prevent memorization overfitting
The open-source course creation tool space is fragmented — most tools are under 50 stars, with LearnHouse being the clear leader

angles: Self-learning course creators are shifting from traditional LMS (Moodle) to modern, AI-powered platforms
Gamification and skill-tree visualization are emerging as key differentiators for developer self-learning
Code execution with auto-grading is a must-have feature for developer-focused course platforms
AI-generated content (lessons, activities, podcasts) is the newest trend, reducing course creation time
The market is fragmented — most tools are early-stage (< 50 stars) with LearnHouse as the notable exception
Self-hosted/open-source alternatives to Kajabi/Teachable are gaining traction among developer-creators
